description: Community PSA/Stellantis telecoding tool reference data (ECU zone/parameter definitions used for UDS coding, plus per-family DTC catalogs and the ISO 14229 failure-type table). Not specific to any vehicle profile in this project and not verified against real hardware here.

contents.dtc/*.json: Per-ECU-family DTC code to description lookup tables.
contents.dtc_failure_types.json: ISO 14229-1 failure-type sub-byte lookup (generic standard table).
contents.ident_uds_ecu.json: Generic PSA identification DID definitions (e.g. F080 ZA_ZONE) used across ECU families.
contents.ecu_families.json: Supplier-assigned ECU family code map (imported for reference, not yet wired into a decode path).
contents.ecu_suppliers.json: ECU supplier code map (imported for reference, not yet wired into a decode path).
contents.ecu_definitions/<FAMILY>/*.json: Per-ECU telecoding zone definitions (UDS zones 0x2100/0x2101): CFG_* configuration parameters with byte offset, bitmask and named option values.

warning: Community source, GPL-2.0. Telecoding zone/parameter names describe vehicle configuration options, not live sensor values. Read-only interpretation is available for every imported definition. A structured option is eligible for writing only through OpenDiag's separately disabled snapshot/diff/VIN/concurrency-check workflow; KWP variants, raw strings, identification zones and unknown values remain non-writable.
